reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Provision of a senior loan of up to EUR 25 million to public electricity generation utility JSC Elektrani na Severna Makedonija ("ESM") for implementing a 30 MW solar photovoltaic ("PV") project consisting of: (i) a 10MW "Oslomej" expansion (currently under construction) on the exhausted coal mine of TPP Oslomej, and (ii) a 20MW "Bitola" expansion adjacent to TPP Bitola (together the "Project"). The project is part of a broad partnership with the North Macedonian authorities and ESM to promote a just and green transition, encompassing investment in new green capacity for ESM, adding clean renewable energy generation to a region and country with serious capacity shortages and high reliance on lignite mining.

The project is part of a broad partnership with the North Macedonian authorities and ESM to promote a just and green transition, encompassing investment in new green capacity for ESM, adding clean renewable energy generation to a region and country with serious capacity shortages and high reliance on lignite mining.
